data.title: 中野四叶 · 清晨露天风吕的澄澈池畔
data.description: 初秋清晨的山间露天温泉池畔，白雾袅袅升腾于幽静的竹林之间。四叶浸润在纯净温热的泉水中，白皙的肩头泛着淡淡粉晕，水珠顺着手臂与锁骨滑落。当她转过身看到走近的身影时，双手下意识护在胸前，脸颊瞬间红透，眼眸中流露出纯粹无邪的羞涩。
data.action: soaking in hot spring, arms crossed over chest, steam rising, deep blush
data.lighting: crisp morning mountain sunlight through bamboo trees
data.promptProse: Bathed in the morning mist of a secluded mountain hot spring, Nakano Yotsuba rests in the crystal-clear steaming water. Sunlight sparkles on the droplets sliding down her bare shoulders as she blushes innocently, covering her chest with shy modesty.
data.animaCaption: Yotsuba blushing shyly in a peaceful morning hot spring.
